plan.H1_final_topic_split: proportional to frame counts within H1 cue bucket, positive minimum per populated leaf
plan.allocation: existing deterministic capped largest-deficit allocator; one seat per populated leaf; lexical tie break; record capacity redistribution; fail if source totals unavailable
plan.analysis_population: frozen residual eligible frame in the stated six cells, conditional on prior target exclusions

conditional_trends.bootstrap: global stable author clusters, monthly equal-author summaries, paired own2025 baselines, 95% conditional bands
conditional_trends.firsthand_capacity: not inferable from lexicon; candidate strata only, no passenger-mix adjustment without evidence
conditional_trends.label: lexicon, exploratory, validated against model labels only
conditional_trends.polarization: lexical endpoint/near-zero score distribution only; semantic extreme/moderate not identified by tone validation

future_primary_analysis.H1: H1 arm only, H1 marginal weights; topic arm/combined union sensitivity
future_primary_analysis.H2_H4: all union Norwegian Q3 2026 items, union weights, unchanged domains
future_primary_analysis.peer_topics: matched period/month/kind/cue design; not matched customers or equivalent policies

gold_topup.future_error_groups: six expansion source-quarter groups; H1-only subset is SRS conditional on its realized gold count; if combining old pilot, retain21 old+6 new groups for simultaneous bounds
gold_topup.old_200: separate pilot validation wave, not silently pooled
gold_topup.rare_classes: no promised pass; targeted challenge sets require a separate future plan and cannot replace probability gold
gold_topup.selection: SRS by independent hash rank within combined expansion source x quarter, irrespective of cues, arm or presumed eligibility

plan.known_prior_evidence: v3 model-labelled pilot results; no new labels or lexicon/model associations inspected
plan.label_guide: unchanged CODEBOOK.md and CODEBOOK_SCHEMA.json; existing v3 evidence schema

lexicon_validation_rule.calibration: weighted score-midrank decile floor(10*midrank)+1 capped at10; preserve ties; empty bins explicit
lexicon_validation_rule.decision: usable only if every global and community gate passes for all three references; missing gate fails closed
lexicon_validation_rule.eligible: in_scope=yes, language=en, overall_tone in negative/neutral/positive; target item text only
lexicon_validation_rule.mixed: excluded from ordinal/sign gate, retained as a separate calibration/disposition category
lexicon_validation_rule.no_tuning: small-lexicon-v1 remains unchanged; no thresholds or lexicon terms changed after evaluation
lexicon_validation_rule.period_gating: diagnostic only; global and each-community rules above are the only operational usability gates
lexicon_validation_rule.periods: all source x UTC month and quarter; fixed Q3-year cells displayed; sparse/undefined not hidden
lexicon_validation_rule.scope: model-reference screen only; no human validation, passenger calibration, or confirmatory inference
lexicon_validation_rule.unclear_unresolved: excluded with coverage denominators; never imputed neutral
lexicon_validation_rule.weighting: inverse pilot inclusion probability; weighted tied midranks for Spearman
lexicon_validation_rule.zero_score: sign zero; counts as error/abstention for positive or negative model tone, never dropped

plan.not_excluded: prior contexts, exact text copies with distinct IDs, whole threads; report exposures, no silent exclusions

power.claims: stage1 operational/diagnostic evidence only; no confirmatory H1 power claim or margin widening

plan.rank_stream: one SHA256 permutation per common atomic leaf

regexes.cut_fas: \b(?:free at sea|more at sea|fas|mas|drink package|beverage package|gratuities|gratuity)\b
regexes.package: \b(?:free at sea|more at sea|fas|mas|drink package|beverage package|gratuities|gratuity)\b

plan.selection: first n_H1 positions in common-leaf permutation to H1; next n_topic to topic; no duplicates

shards.assignment: balance each arm/source/quarter across five, then hash-shuffle each shard

plan.topic_final_H1_split: proportional to planned residual counts within topic bucket, positive minimum per populated leaf
